lastCompletedStory.title: Document the sync-read carve-out to the Bun-first invariant

nextStoryContext: US-001 was a docs-only change amending the curated 'Bun-only' invariant bullet in scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md to carve out synchronous point-reads (readFileSync/existsSync/appendFileSync) from the Bun-first rule, and appending a cross-referencing bullet to scripts/cam/patterns.md citing the two pre-existing precedents (src/config/toml.ts loadConfig, src/supervisor/events.ts default logger). No src/ file was touched, no reader was migrated to Bun.file. Verified templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md is a generic placeholder skeleton with no 'Bun-only' bullet, so no re-embed was needed (embed-vendor:check confirmed clean).
